purpose.summary: Publish reviewed policy coverage with the discovery proposal
purpose.rationale: Applying the proposed policy requires durable coverage receipts for its changed policy units. These audit requests ask the Engine to publish receipts only after actual consumer-inventory evidence and audit review are complete; they do not change the proposed wording or certify coverage now.

edits.rationale: Inventory actual semantic consumers within audit-horizon.policy-impact-consumers, review the proposed relationships and consumer dispositions, and publish only the evidence-backed coverage claim accepted for this exact proposal.
